csv_project_name: Planning Services for Bailey Road/ Highway 115 Turn Lanes
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Cornelius is seeking a qualified firm to provide planning services for intersection improvements at the Bailey Road (SR 2416) and Highway 115 (Old Statesville Rd) intersection. The Town received CRTPO grant funding for this plan. This is a complex intersection with railroad tracks (future Red Line) immediately adjacent as well as Hough High School and Bailey Middle School just to the east. The westbound Bailey Road leg is the intersection that sees the most congestion primarily during pick-up and drop-off times for Hough High School and Bailey Middle School. However, the study needs to look at all four approaches. The study should investigate and recommend potential solutions to increase capacity, such as but not limited to: 1) Adding a dedicated left turn lane to westbound Bailey, 2) Signal retiming to release more westbound Bailey traffic, 3) A super street concept, The Town will want the firm to identify and develop other potential solutions that will be discussed prior to conducting deeper modeling and conceptual design.
